name: @relay/visual-tooling
description: Self-contained visual-verification tooling for the relay Figma Implementation Track (Phase 6 — Visual loop). Provisions a headless Chromium browser, captures per-frame screenshots against a Design Spec's Visual Acceptance Criteria table, and runs an AA-tolerant pixel diff against the reference PNGs. Kept fully separate from the repo root package.json so a non-Figma project never pays the Playwright/Chromium install cost.
